## Hypothesis

Increasing the chart stop buffer for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON will reduce premature stop-outs on moderate retraces, allowing more of the winner potential to be captured on 4/29 and 5/01, while maintaining discipline on loser days by relying on the chart structure for invalidation.

## Mechanism

Change the chart stop buffer from $0.50 to $1.00 in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup. The chart stop triggers when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer. A larger buffer gives the trade more room to move against the position before triggering the stop, reducing whipsaw exits on days like 4/29 and 5/01 where the market may retrace before continuing the move.
